results.title: Dinesh Chauhan elected Bar Assn president in Jagadhri
results.description: Advocate Dinesh Chauhan has been elected president of the District Bar Association, Jagadhri, defeating his nearest rival Pardeep Rathore by a margin of 558 votes.
